    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Shipping">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCompany</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NormalPostShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Shipping_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Parallel_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WritePackageLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_LogisticsDepartmentHead" name="Logistics department head">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Insurance_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Insurance_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OffersToSelect" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToShippingJoin" sourceRef="Task_SelectCompany" targetRef="Gateway_Shipping_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostToShippingJoin" sourceRef="Task_NormalPostShipment" targetRef="Gateway_Shipping_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToParallelSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_Shipping_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPackageLabel" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_WritePackageLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToInsuranceSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPackageGoods" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Split" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceNecessary" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance_Split" targetRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${insuranceNecessary}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceNotNecessary" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceToJoin" sourceRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceJoinToReady" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToReady" sourceRef="Task_WritePackageLabel" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackageToReady" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyToPrepare" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Join" targetRef="Task_PrepareForPickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareToEnd" sourceRef="Task_PrepareForPickup" targetRef="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup"/>

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Packaging_Split" name="Start clarification and packaging"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClarifyShipper" name="Clarify shipper"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Package goods"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InviteCompanies" name="Invite three logistic companies to make offers"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPostShipment" name="Use normal post shipment"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WritePackageLabel" name="Write package label"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeParcelInsurance" name="Take parcel insurance"/>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Insurance_Join" name="Label and insurance done"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Ready_Join" name="Shipping preparation and packaging done"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Ready_Check" name="Everything ready?" default="Flow_NotReady"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareForPickup" name="Prepare goods for pickup"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToPackagingSplit" sourceRef="StartEvent_GoodsToShip" targetRef="Gateway_Packaging_Split"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClarifyToSizeSplit" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipper" targetRef="Gateway_Size_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LargeAmount" name="Large amount" sourceRef="Gateway_Size_Split" targetRef="Task_InviteCompanies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${largeAmount}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SmallAmount" name="Small amount" sourceRef="Gateway_Size_Split" targetRef="Task_NormalPostShipment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!largeAmount}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InviteToSelect" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Task_SelectCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectToShippingMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectCompany" targetRef="Gateway_Shipping_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostToShippingMerge" sourceRef="Task_NormalPostShipment" targetRef="Gateway_Shipping_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToInsuranceSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_Shipping_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToPackageLabel" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance_Split" targetRef="Task_WritePackageLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuranceNecessary" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance_Split" targetRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackageToReadyJoin" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyJoinToCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyToPrepare" name="Ready" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Check" targetRef="Task_PrepareForPickup">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${everythingReady}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReady" name="Not ready" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Check" targetRef="EndEvent_NotReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareToEnd" sourceRef="Task_PrepareForPickup" targetRef="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup"/>
